title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for the differential scattering cross section.

title: Use of Born Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Born approximation formula for scattering.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct steps in evaluating the integral involving the potential.

title: Correct Variables
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly define and use the variables q, A, and a throughout the solution.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the calculations, particularly in the integration steps.
